assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: finished portrait 2:3 background painting for a mobile first-person arcade mafia shooter, Stage 2 'Black Wharf', Wave 1. One coherent scene, no panels. To left, moored black cargo ship, timber pier, iron bollards, coils of rope, dockside crane silhouetted further back. 1930s-inspired fictional port, NO modern shipping containers, no neon signs. Wet gray stone paving, after-rain puddles, dawn just before sunrise, overcast pearl-gray sky, thin distant sea fog, cool desaturated teal and silver, rusty red iron accents, only small warm practical lamps. Rich highly detailed cinematic illustrated game environment, realistic architecture, not cartoon, not dark unreadable silhouette, clearly readable objects. Composition designed for shooting gameplay: medium-distance wooden crate stacks and a handcart left and right of center at 40-60% image height, visible floor and multiple clear enemy standing locations around them; most important architecture in central 70% width. Generous unobstructed wet ground in lower third for controls. Camera not ultra wide, not overhead, stable single-point perspective. Make warehouse entrance clearly the next destination. No characters, no police, no boss, no enemies, no weapons in foreground, no crosshair, no UI, no typography, no watermark. Keep sky upper quarter only.
